findings.why: G21LJ-V19-SF1 established the recital rule: when a predecessor is rejected and left unrecorded, the successor adds it. G21LJ-V23-SF2 extended that rule to the normative doesNot parallel and required the omitted v21 and v22 standings. v24 correctly performs those two repairs, yet it is itself the successor to rejected, unrecorded v23 and leaves that newest standing out of the same selectively enumerated fields. An auditor reading the two recitals sees the recent unrecorded siblings enumerated and would reasonably infer that v23 is not in that category.

No field records v23 as current. The defect is therefore an incomplete pair of recitals, not a false currency claim, digest error, obligation error, or failed landing of G21LJ-V23-SF2. This matches the prior lineage grade of SHOULD-FIX for the same omission class.
